verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs clearly describe a server-driven Terminal API using JSON messages to make payments, refunds, tipping, and testing (adyen-pos-docs-17, -1, -9, -10, -12), which matches the story. However, a hands-on community report describes being forced into an older COM-based integration rather than the promised JSON-only flow, costing hundreds of hours before abandoning Adyen, directly contradicting the simplicity claim for at least some POS hardware/integration paths (adyen-pos-comm-1). missing for 10: independent corroboration that the JSON Terminal API works smoothly in practice across common POS hardware, and resolution of the COM-vs-JSON discrepancy.
